purpose: Provide an independent official-KRX expected scope for Gate-C coverage audits without deriving expected keys from the same Data Marketplace status/investor-flow observations being audited.

trading_date_and_trade_scope.sweep_rule: Query every calendar date in the frozen research period; never infer a trading calendar from weekday/holiday rules.
trading_date_and_trade_scope.trading_date_rule: A date is eligible as an official observed trading-date scope only when the authenticated response is non-empty and every returned BAS_DD equals the requested date.
trading_date_and_trade_scope.empty_date_rule: An empty response is evidence only that this exact request produced no daily-trade rows; it must not be silently converted into a trading day.

same_date_security_identity.request_rule: Request the same date only after the daily-trade response for that date is non-empty.
same_date_security_identity.common_stock_rule: MKT_TP_NM identifies KOSPI scope and SECUGRP_NM/KIND_STKCERT_TP_NM must explicitly establish common-stock identity.
same_date_security_identity.stable_join_rule: Join exact ISU_CD on the same requested date; name-only joins are forbidden.

investor_flow.rule: Use the exact same-date intersection of non-empty KOSPI daily-trade rows and same-date officially attested common-stock identity rows joined by ISU_CD. Never add a missing security/date or synthesize a zero-flow row.

security_status.rule: For each independently observed trading date, use all same-date officially attested KOSPI common-stock identity rows from the basic-info response. Never infer an identity row from later snapshots.
